decisions.reason: The mitred lever family has stayed on the website through 2024 as part of the firm's coordinated handle ranges, and the tooling and finishing already invested in it argue for keeping it despite its low visibility.

In 2024 the multifunctional lever was promoted to a page of its own, a visible public commitment that fits the firm's announced barrier-free and system direction, so dropping it within a year is unlikely.
The lever is still listed and costs little to keep in a broad certified range, but it has only ever been mentioned, so it carries some risk of being pruned like Product A.
The FSB 1289 collection is heavily invested in, has its own page, and is publicly celebrated with the German Design Award and the iF Design Award, so the firm is strongly committed to keeping it.
